answer: One defense is a bonded identity kernel: each agent must lock a meaningful stake before it can trade, and that stake is slashed if it misbehaves. Like tending an orchard, reputation then grows slowly over verified work, not overnight, so a glacier-slow history cannot be faked instantly. An attacker creating thousands of fake agents must fund every stake and wait out the same slow growth, making a Sybil flood expensive and unprofitable.
